notes.title: Weekly update (8)
notes.notes:
Super Secret Settings
 """RTX""" support (totally not just some lens flare shader)
 fixed a bug regarding the loading of helicopters
 the music waits to play until after half a second has passed since you opened the game
             (what used to happen is that the music played at full volume
              for a split second even if you had lowered it in the settings)

notes.title: Weekly update (4)
notes.notes: This week I've focused on adding around 25 or so new achievements along with polishing out a few bugs here and there, I've also gotten hand of a ton of sprites that I'll use for skins to your pet Beaver :)

notes.title: Weekly update (3)
notes.notes:
Tweaked the save system to allow the player to have any number of saves, currently limited to 3.
If you switch to another save the other save's won't advance in time, essentially unloaded saves are treated like if the game was closed

notes.title: Weekly update (2)
notes.notes:
the prestige scaling isn't as steep now

fixed the logs until next soul counter, as it was tracking the wrong variables
added a display so you can see your current prestige level

notes.title: Weekly update (1?)
notes.notes:
The game has gotten it's prestige system released, there's currently no upgrades associated with it, but most of the backend stuff for it is done. Each beaver soul you obtain (yeah souls, morbid i know) will also increase your LPS (logs per second) by 1%

I've also started testing and playing around with the possibility of networking (Ooo??), if you're one of the few who have access to the game you can go into the network test tab, create a lobby, and if *somehow* anyone joins your lobby you'll be able to talk with each other :) - p.s the networking is still a bit rough and you're going to experience bugs when it comes to joining lobbies that doesn't exist and stuff but i'll get around to fixing it soonish

notes.title: Version 0.3
notes.notes:
Current Features:
The game currently has 14 friends, squirrel thru truckbowel, more planned for the future.
Currently 11 upgrades without names for all friends.
Finished save system.
Discord rich presence support.
Finished settings menu.

In The Works:
Prestige system, mostly complete but lacks polish, so it remains inaccessible for testers.
Adding in names and descriptions for all the upgrades.

To Be Added:
Pet beaver.
Ability to play custom songs.
The game will probably end up having 100 achievements, which is what steam caps it at.
More upgrades independent from friends you've bought.
Redo a fair bit of the sprites, like the tree, truckbowel, and so on.
Proper controller support, game has some but eeehhh-
